mentions.name: Sightread
mentions.description: This web app generates sheet music for practicing sight reading and music dictation. It currently focuses on rhythm-only exercises and recently added support for asymmetric (odd) rhythms such as 7/8.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just pushed another update to https://sightread.org which generates sheet music to practice sight reading and music dictation. Still rhythm-only, now with support for asymmetric (odd) rhythms like 7/8

mentions.name: SightRead
mentions.description: A free, ad-free web app for practicing music sight reading, built in vanilla JavaScript (using the abcjs notation library). Currently supports rhythm-only practice, with more features planned.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://SightRead.org - free, ad-free, etc, vanilla js (except for the abcjs notation library) web app to practice sight reading. Currently rhythm-only, but more is planned.
